rationale: Cover cancellation vs completion races and DB-level concurrency-limit enforcement. 1: cancel while handler in-progress (2 steps) tests best-effort vs overwrite. 2: zero-step handler likely completes before post-claim cancel tests completed-unaffected. 3: inverted enqueue/priority under limit=1 tests priority-first dispatch. 4: 2 workers limit=1 with long handlers tests serialisation/slot uniqueness. 5: 3 jobs 2 workers limit=2 tests max-2 parallelism. 6: cancel of still-queued second job while first runs under limit=1 tests queued-cancel prevents start despite handler ignoring scope.
